name: Medallion Licensing
description: Medallion Licensing helps healthcare providers obtain and manage medical licenses across multiple states. The service handles the full license application process, renewals, and Interstate Medical Licensure Compact (IMLC) applications.
short_description: Multi-state medical licensing service handling applications, renewals, and IMLC processing for healthcare providers.
one_liner: Multi-state medical licensing for telehealth providers

pricing.notes: New state licenses typically cost $500-1,500 per license. IMLC processing takes 2-4 weeks.

best_for: Mental health practices expanding to new states
Digital health companies scaling provider networks
not_ideal_for: Providers only practicing in one state

seo.title: Medallion Licensing | HeyPsych
seo.meta_description: Medallion multi-state licensing service for telehealth and mental health providers.

faqs.q: How long does Medallion licensing take?
faqs.a: New state licenses take 4-12 weeks depending on the state. IMLC processing takes 2-4 weeks.

faqs.q: How much does Medallion licensing cost?
faqs.a: New state licenses typically cost $500-1,500 per license depending on the state.
